serverNotReady.where: Library (archive, rename, upload): Error toast/message when the server's database connection is not initialised (rare, transient).

fileNotFound.where: Library: error when archiving/restoring or renaming a chart that no longer exists
fileNotFound.context: 'File' = the chart (sheet-music file) in the library

crossTenantChordCacheWrite.where: Chart viewer: error when saving detected chords/key for a chart that belongs to another congregation's library (normally never seen)
crossTenantChordCacheWrite.context: Lower-case is intentional (technical message). 'chord-cache' = saved chord positions/key detected on a chart.

missingFileId.where: Chart viewer: error when a chord-cache request named no chart
missingFileId.context: 'fileId' is a technical field name; may stay as-is

chordsVerifiedNeedsMusician.where: Chart viewer: error when someone who is not signed in as a musician tries to mark a chart's chords as verified
chordsVerifiedNeedsMusician.context: 'chordsVerified' is a technical field name ('chords verified' flag); may stay as-is

displayNameEmpty.where: Library: error when renaming a chart to a blank title
displayNameEmpty.context: 'displayName' is the chart title field; translators may say 'The title cannot be empty.'

fileIdsRequired.where: Library page: error when the song-usage badge request named no charts (developer error, rarely shown)

tooManyFileIds.where: Library page: error when the song-usage badge request asked about too many charts at once (developer error, rarely shown)

uploadPermissionRequired.where: Library upload dialog: error when the user is not allowed to upload charts

noFileProvided.where: Library upload dialog: error when the upload contained no file

uploaded.where: Library upload dialog: success message after a chart was uploaded
uploaded.context: {title} is the chart's title, shown in quotes

uploadEmptyFile.where: Library upload: error when the chosen file is empty

uploadTooLarge.where: Library upload: error when the file is over the size limit

uploadMimeUnspecific.where: Library upload: error when the browser sent no file type
uploadMimeUnspecific.context: Technical: keep the MIME types (application/pdf etc.) exactly as written.

uploadMimeUnsupported.where: Library upload: error when the file type is not accepted
uploadMimeUnsupported.context: {mimeType} is the file's type; {allowed} is the list of accepted types (technical, keep as is).

uploadUnknownCollection.where: Library upload: error when the chosen library section does not exist
uploadUnknownCollection.context: {collection} is the requested section id; {allowed} the list of valid ids (keep as is).

uploadMuseScoreFailed.where: Library upload: error when a MuseScore file could not be converted
uploadMuseScoreFailed.context: {detail} is a technical error message in English; leave it as is.

uploadHeicFailed.where: Library upload: error when an iPhone (HEIC) photo could not be converted
uploadHeicFailed.context: {detail} is a technical error message in English; leave it as is.

uploadDuplicateExact.where: Library upload: error when a chart with exactly this name is already in the library
uploadDuplicateExact.context: {existingName} is the existing chart's name. 'force: true' is a technical option name; keep it as written. 'chart' = sheet music file.

uploadDuplicateSimilar.where: Library upload: error when a chart with a very similar name is already in the library
uploadDuplicateSimilar.context: {existingName} is the existing chart's name. 'force: true' is a technical option name; keep it as written.

uploadStorageMissing.where: Library upload: rare server error after storing the file failed silently

uploadStorageSizeMismatch.where: Library upload: rare server error when the stored file's size does not match

uploadIndexWriteFailed.where: Library upload: rare server error when saving the library entry failed
uploadIndexWriteFailed.context: {detail} is a technical error message in English; leave it as is.
